title: Soft Foliage
description:
Leaves shouldn't get in your way. Softer leaf blocks, lilypads, and more!
Actively updating for all versions after and including 26.1.2!
Config toggles for player, vehicles (boat/horse/etc) and lilypads! <3 <3 <3
body:
# Soft Foliage by KMV
## Foliage but more fun!!! 

### Current Features
- Soft Platforms (temp collision from top of soft foliage for navigation)
- Soft Foliage (disables collision for leaf blocks and lilypads)
- Extensive Config (currently only accessible in config folder)
- Players toggle (no other mobs for now, except vehicles)
- Vehicles toggle (horses, boats, etc grouped for now)
- Lilypads included (boats break them rudely, will fix sometime)

##

### Future Features
- Config Screen ingame
- Slowdown option
- Mobs of varying types selectable from all, hostile, friendly, passive, player support mobs
- Items selectable
- Visual/Audio Feedback


##


### KMV's Promise:
My work focuses on maximum **compatibility** and **accessibility**, or ease of use. I ensure it with the following:
- Any **Soft Foliage** mod jars are compatible with *any version* **26.1 or later**, *even if not marked for that version on modrinth*. 
  - Specific guaranteed compatibility window is **26.1 -> 26.3-snapshot-2** and I will expand that window as the game updates further. 

Contact me through my [Discord](https://discord.gg/XU8DDH3Fr2) server to report bugs or incompatibilities.
